description.value: Stong's Market Northwoods is an award-winning, locally owned independent grocery store on Dollarton Highway, a popular cycling corridor leading to Deep Cove. It stocks major brands alongside local, gourmet, and organic products across specialized departments covering fresh produce, bakery, deli, seafood, and wellness. The store has been recognized as a Canadian Independent Grocer of the Year and the 2025 North Vancouver Chamber Business of the Year.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for stongs.com is fully accessible and confirms this is the Northwoods location at 2150 Dollarton Hwy, North Vancouver with phone 604-973-0700, matching OSM tags. The site describes a full-service independent grocery store with multiple specialized departments (produce, bakery, deli, seafood, etc.) and notes a café ordering feature in its app, but neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null. The business is clearly active, recently won the 2025 North Vancouver Chamber Business of the Year award, and serves a route cyclists commonly use to reach Deep Cove.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, full-service independent grocery store on a key North Vancouver cycling corridor to Deep Cove; clearly useful to touring cyclists for resupply even without confirmed cycling-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: The app description mentions café order functionality, suggesting hot/prepared food may be available in-store, but this could not be confirmed explicitly from website text.

wow_evidence: Canadian Independent Grocer of the Year and the 2025 North Vancouver Chamber Business of the Year
